545c2c84-018f-4570-a01c-753823feaeac.basic: A shot on goal means kicking the ball toward the net. A save means the goalkeeper stops it. Mac Allister shot and the goalkeeper saved it.
545c2c84-018f-4570-a01c-753823feaeac.intermediate: Mac Allister tested the French goalkeeper with a shot from central position in the attacking third, in minute 4, with the score 0-0.
545c2c84-018f-4570-a01c-753823feaeac.tactical: Mac Allister placed a shot on target from the central attacking third in minute 4, 0-0, and the French goalkeeper saved.

6d498191-05f0-432c-8764-03aea4ef9fb8.basic: A shot is an attempt to score. Di María shot from inside the penalty area, but the ball went off target.
6d498191-05f0-432c-8764-03aea4ef9fb8.intermediate: Di María took a shot from inside France's penalty area in minute 16, with the score at 0-0, but it went off target.
6d498191-05f0-432c-8764-03aea4ef9fb8.tactical: Di María attempted a shot from the central penalty area at 0-0 in the 16th minute of the 2022 final, the effort going off target.

6d527ebc-a948-4cd8-ac82-daced35bb715.basic: A penalty kick is a free shot at goal, one-on-one with the goalkeeper. Messi scored one, giving Argentina the lead.
6d527ebc-a948-4cd8-ac82-daced35bb715.intermediate: Messi scored a penalty kick in minute 22, putting Argentina ahead 1-0 in the 2022 final.
6d527ebc-a948-4cd8-ac82-daced35bb715.tactical: Messi converted from the penalty spot in minute 22, giving Argentina a 1-0 lead in the 2022 final.

d49e9601-1cbf-4df7-9a77-16877abe49dc.basic: Offside means a player is too far ahead when the ball is played. Messi was offside in the attacking area. Score stayed one nil.
d49e9601-1cbf-4df7-9a77-16877abe49dc.intermediate: Messi was caught offside in Argentina's attacking third on the right side in minute 29, with Argentina leading one nil.
d49e9601-1cbf-4df7-9a77-16877abe49dc.tactical: Messi flagged offside in the attacking third, right channel, minute 29. Argentina one, France nil. No change to the scoreline.

f227a92e-d86c-4f3d-aa75-5ccb71adcae6.basic: A shot is when a player kicks the ball trying to score. Mac Allister kicked toward goal but missed the target badly.
f227a92e-d86c-4f3d-aa75-5ccb71adcae6.intermediate: Mac Allister fired wide from the left side of the attacking third in the 31st minute, with Argentina leading 1-0.
f227a92e-d86c-4f3d-aa75-5ccb71adcae6.tactical: Mac Allister's effort from the left channel of the final third went wayward in the 31st minute, Argentina 1-0 up.

ef86f4d9-7acd-4ed0-a5ec-9129079e8fbe.basic: A goal is when the ball goes into the net. Di María shot into the net, making it 2-0.
ef86f4d9-7acd-4ed0-a5ec-9129079e8fbe.intermediate: Di María scored for Argentina in minute 35, putting them 2-0 up against France in the 2022 final.
ef86f4d9-7acd-4ed0-a5ec-9129079e8fbe.tactical: Di María converted inside the penalty area in the 35th minute of the 2022 final, extending Argentina's lead to 2-0 against France.

af8c7775-091a-4905-aeb3-484b9a99de81.basic: A yellow card is an official warning given to a player for breaking the rules. Enzo Fernandez received one in midfield.
af8c7775-091a-4905-aeb3-484b9a99de81.intermediate: Enzo Fernandez was shown a yellow card for a foul in midfield on the left side, in minute 51, with Argentina leading 2-0.
af8c7775-091a-4905-aeb3-484b9a99de81.tactical: Fernandez was booked for a foul in the left channel of midfield, minute 51, Argentina 2-0 France.

13a4889d-ad08-41be-9125-24c4c7d7879a.basic: A shot on goal is when a player kicks the ball at the net. De Paul shot and the French goalkeeper saved it.
13a4889d-ad08-41be-9125-24c4c7d7879a.intermediate: De Paul shot from inside the penalty area in minute 48, but the French goalkeeper saved it. Argentina led 2-0.
13a4889d-ad08-41be-9125-24c4c7d7879a.tactical: De Paul tested the French goalkeeper from central positions inside the final third at 48 minutes. Shot saved, score 2-0 to Argentina.

5683007d-fde4-40ee-aa5e-c1624424b24e.basic: A yellow card is a warning given to a player for breaking the rules. Rabiot received a yellow card in midfield.
5683007d-fde4-40ee-aa5e-c1624424b24e.intermediate: Rabiot was shown a yellow card for a foul in the left side of midfield in the 54th minute, with France trailing 2-0.
5683007d-fde4-40ee-aa5e-c1624424b24e.tactical: Rabiot was booked for a foul on the left side of the midfield zone in the 54th minute, France trailing 2-0.

43691970-1dad-4e11-bd29-48f640c55ea1.basic: A shot on goal means kicking the ball toward the net. A save means the goalkeeper stops it. Álvarez shot and the goalkeeper saved it.
43691970-1dad-4e11-bd29-48f640c55ea1.intermediate: Álvarez shot from inside the penalty area on the left at minute 58, with Argentina leading 2-0, and the goalkeeper saved it.
43691970-1dad-4e11-bd29-48f640c55ea1.tactical: Álvarez tested the goalkeeper from the left channel inside the penalty area at 58 minutes, Argentina leading 2-0, shot saved.

be78b6e9-2f19-4620-9e4b-b518bd562537.basic: Offside means a player is too far ahead when the ball is played. Theo Hernández's pass in midfield was ruled offside, stopping the move.
be78b6e9-2f19-4620-9e4b-b518bd562537.intermediate: Theo Hernández played a pass from the left side of midfield in the 58th minute, but it was ruled offside, with France trailing 2-0.
be78b6e9-2f19-4620-9e4b-b518bd562537.tactical: Hernández's left-sided midfield pass was flagged offside in the 58th minute, cutting short a France build-up phase with the scoreline at 2-0 to Argentina.

9f6285ff-9b32-4a46-a4a0-74c1ca89276c.basic: A shot is when a player kicks the ball to try to score. Kolo Muani shot but missed the target.
9f6285ff-9b32-4a46-a4a0-74c1ca89276c.intermediate: Kolo Muani took a shot from inside the penalty area in the 67th minute, but it went off target. France trailed 2-0.
9f6285ff-9b32-4a46-a4a0-74c1ca89276c.tactical: Kolo Muani attempted a shot from the central penalty area in the 67th minute, going off target. France trailed 2-0.

b2d43671-a3e6-4709-9c0c-646442c1074c.basic: A shot is when a player kicks the ball to try to score. Mbappé shot but it went off target.
b2d43671-a3e6-4709-9c0c-646442c1074c.intermediate: Mbappé took a shot from inside Argentina's penalty area in the 70th minute, with France trailing 2-0, but it went off target.
b2d43671-a3e6-4709-9c0c-646442c1074c.tactical: Mbappé attempted a shot from the central penalty area in the 70th minute, France trailing 2-0, the effort going off target.

6cc0d5e2-6999-4006-8a7a-34de4cbe3ffd.basic: A penalty kick is a free shot on goal, one-on-one with the goalkeeper. Mbappé scored for France, making it 2-1.
6cc0d5e2-6999-4006-8a7a-34de4cbe3ffd.intermediate: Mbappé converted a penalty kick for France in the 79th minute, pulling the score back to 2-1 against Argentina.
6cc0d5e2-6999-4006-8a7a-34de4cbe3ffd.tactical: Mbappé converted from the spot in the 79th minute, reducing the deficit to 2-1, France trailing Argentina inside the penalty area, centre.

7b1441f1-4911-44d7-ac4b-f3f8f11daa76.basic: An assist means a pass that leads directly to a goal. Thuram passed to Mbappé, who scored to make it 2-2.
7b1441f1-4911-44d7-ac4b-f3f8f11daa76.intermediate: Thuram played the pass in the attacking third that set up Mbappé's goal in minute 80, levelling the score at 2-2.
7b1441f1-4911-44d7-ac4b-f3f8f11daa76.tactical: Thuram's assist in the final third, minute 80, released Mbappé, whose finish levelled the game at 2-2 in the 2022 final.

03fb2918-e1e7-4ec8-89ff-7bc5531e853d.basic: A goal means the ball fully crosses the line into the net. Mbappé scored, making it 2-2.
03fb2918-e1e7-4ec8-89ff-7bc5531e853d.intermediate: Mbappé scored from inside the penalty area in minute 80, pulling France level at 2-2 in the 2022 final.
03fb2918-e1e7-4ec8-89ff-7bc5531e853d.tactical: Mbappé converted from central positions inside the penalty area, minute 80, bringing France to 2-2 in the 2022 final.

fe277079-395a-4ff3-bb29-e99d93014014.basic: A shot is when a player kicks the ball to try to score. Enzo Fernandez's shot was blocked.
fe277079-395a-4ff3-bb29-e99d93014014.intermediate: Enzo Fernandez fired a shot from the centre of the attacking third in minute 83, with the score at 2-2, but it was blocked.
fe277079-395a-4ff3-bb29-e99d93014014.tactical: Fernandez tested from central positions in the final third at 2-2, minute 83, but the shot was blocked before troubling the goalkeeper.

8f75db1a-1ee2-4ff8-b211-1c46d9a76a69.basic: A yellow card is an official warning given to a player. France's Thuram received one inside Argentina's penalty area at 2-2.
8f75db1a-1ee2-4ff8-b211-1c46d9a76a69.intermediate: Thuram was booked for a foul inside Argentina's penalty area in the 86th minute, with the score 2-2 in the 2022 final.
8f75db1a-1ee2-4ff8-b211-1c46d9a76a69.tactical: Thuram received a yellow card for a foul in the attacking penalty area in the 86th minute, score level at 2-2 in the 2022 final.

22fea401-6836-45bb-bfbd-fadd4ed0b237.basic: Offside means a teammate was too far ahead when the ball was played. Upamecano passed, but the move was ruled offside.
22fea401-6836-45bb-bfbd-fadd4ed0b237.intermediate: Upamecano's pass in midfield was ruled offside for France in the 90th minute, with the score at 2-2.
22fea401-6836-45bb-bfbd-fadd4ed0b237.tactical: Upamecano's central midfield pass was flagged offside, halting a France attack at 2-2 in the 90th minute of the 2022 final.

867b8791-49c0-4d98-a976-c0b4cfc1cb5a.basic: A shot on goal means kicking the ball toward the net. A save means the goalkeeper stops it. Messi shot and the goalkeeper saved it.
867b8791-49c0-4d98-a976-c0b4cfc1cb5a.intermediate: Messi shot from a central position in the attacking third in minute 96, with the score at 2-2, and the goalkeeper saved it.
867b8791-49c0-4d98-a976-c0b4cfc1cb5a.tactical: Messi attempted a shot from the central attacking third in the 96th minute, game state level at 2-2 in the 2022 final. The goalkeeper saved.

4b295434-7285-4337-95b4-26395b799643.basic: A yellow card is an official warning given to a player for breaking the rules. Acuña received a yellow card in the 2022 final.
4b295434-7285-4337-95b4-26395b799643.intermediate: Acuña was shown a yellow card for a foul in the attacking third at minute 97, with the score at 2-2.
4b295434-7285-4337-95b4-26395b799643.tactical: Acuña collected a booking for a foul in the final third at 97 minutes, Argentina level with France at 2-2.

d341d94a-a4d0-442a-98df-98d1b852280a.basic: Offside means a player was ahead of defenders illegally. Extra time is bonus time after a tie. Upamecano's pass was offside.
d341d94a-a4d0-442a-98df-98d1b852280a.intermediate: In minute 95 of extra time, with the score 2-2, Upamecano's pass from midfield was ruled offside for France.
d341d94a-a4d0-442a-98df-98d1b852280a.tactical: In the 95th minute of extra time, France level at 2-2, Upamecano played a pass from the left midfield zone that was flagged offside.

bae39b9d-d6b8-4c4b-8840-39b3ac3260e2.basic: Offside means a player is too far ahead when the ball is played. Extra time means 30 more minutes added. Koundé's pass was offside.
bae39b9d-d6b8-4c4b-8840-39b3ac3260e2.intermediate: In minute 100 of extra time, with the score 2-2, Koundé played a pass in the attacking third that was ruled offside.
bae39b9d-d6b8-4c4b-8840-39b3ac3260e2.tactical: Minute 100, extra time, France level 2-2. Koundé's pass in the attacking third, right channel, was called offside.

d3ba40fa-09d6-4488-b17d-672aaa2928d7.basic: A shot is an attempt to score. Extra time is 30 extra minutes played when the score is level. Lautaro Martínez's shot was blocked.
d3ba40fa-09d6-4488-b17d-672aaa2928d7.intermediate: In minute 104 of extra time, with the score at 2-2, Lautaro Martínez shot from inside the penalty area and a defender blocked it.
d3ba40fa-09d6-4488-b17d-672aaa2928d7.tactical: At 2-2 in the 104th minute of extra time, Martínez released a shot from the central penalty area. A defender blocked it, keeping the score level.

5d7d4f2f-62da-4de9-90e3-3660ba17c4f3.basic: A shot is an attempt to score. Extra time is 30 extra minutes played when the score is level. Lautaro Martínez shot and missed the target.
5d7d4f2f-62da-4de9-90e3-3660ba17c4f3.intermediate: In minute 105 of extra time, with the score 2-2, Lautaro Martínez shot from inside the penalty area but missed the target.
5d7d4f2f-62da-4de9-90e3-3660ba17c4f3.tactical: Level at 2-2 in the 105th minute of extra time, Martínez fired from central positions inside the final third but sent his effort off target.

54b889ec-6026-49ea-a913-e883dbe6e301.basic: A goal means the ball goes into the net. Extra time is 30 extra minutes played when teams are level. Messi scored for Argentina.
54b889ec-6026-49ea-a913-e883dbe6e301.intermediate: Messi scored inside the penalty area in minute 107 of extra time, putting Argentina ahead 3-2 against France.
54b889ec-6026-49ea-a913-e883dbe6e301.tactical: Messi converted from central positions inside the final third in the 107th minute, giving Argentina a 3-2 lead in the second period of extra time.

19e301d2-38dd-4cbd-8bc2-61d2b46b9951.basic: A yellow card is a warning to a player. Extra time is thirty more minutes when teams are level after ninety. Paredes was warned for a foul.
19e301d2-38dd-4cbd-8bc2-61d2b46b9951.intermediate: Paredes committed a foul in midfield and received a yellow card in minute 113 of extra time, with Argentina leading France 3-2.
19e301d2-38dd-4cbd-8bc2-61d2b46b9951.tactical: Paredes was booked for a foul on the right side of midfield in the 113th minute of extra time, Argentina leading 3-2.

08f2f203-cdc9-4146-99b6-818c5c32bf70.basic: A shot is an attempt to score. Extra time is 30 bonus minutes. Mbappé's shot was blocked.
08f2f203-cdc9-4146-99b6-818c5c32bf70.intermediate: In minute 115 of extra time, with Argentina leading 3-2, Mbappé's shot from the left was blocked.
08f2f203-cdc9-4146-99b6-818c5c32bf70.tactical: In minute 115 of extra time, Argentina leading 3-2, Mbappé's effort from the left side of the attacking third was blocked.

dcbf6fe6-7b7f-4066-978e-de1a3d6d70ff.basic: A yellow card is a warning. Extra time is bonus time after a draw. Montiel fouled an opponent and was warned.
dcbf6fe6-7b7f-4066-978e-de1a3d6d70ff.intermediate: Montiel committed a foul in Argentina's own half in minute 115 of extra time, receiving a yellow card, with Argentina leading 3-2.
dcbf6fe6-7b7f-4066-978e-de1a3d6d70ff.tactical: Montiel was booked for a foul in Argentina's own half in the 115th minute of extra time, with Argentina ahead 3-2.

d9b92dbd-4fea-4f48-b2fb-d7222eab2dbd.basic: A penalty kick is a free shot from a spot inside the box. Extra time is 30 bonus minutes. Mbappé scored, making it 3-3.
d9b92dbd-4fea-4f48-b2fb-d7222eab2dbd.intermediate: Mbappé converted a penalty kick in minute 117 of extra time, bringing France level at 3-3 against Argentina in the 2022 final.
d9b92dbd-4fea-4f48-b2fb-d7222eab2dbd.tactical: Mbappé converted from the penalty spot in the 117th minute, inside the opponent's penalty area, centre. France level at 3-3 in extra time of the 2022 final.

7963f4cf-e710-42d4-b9ee-2d9b1b7ea12b.basic: Offside means a teammate was too far forward when passed to. Extra time is added play after a tie. Messi's pass was ruled offside.
7963f4cf-e710-42d4-b9ee-2d9b1b7ea12b.intermediate: In minute 121 of extra time, with the score 3-3, Messi played a pass in central midfield but it was ruled offside.
7963f4cf-e710-42d4-b9ee-2d9b1b7ea12b.tactical: In minute 121 of extra time, score level at 3-3, Messi played a central midfield pass that was ruled offside.

959edead-09fb-40b0-b6a3-72e73bd30d5a.basic: A shot on goal means kicking toward the net. A save means the goalkeeper stops it. France's Kolo Muani shot and the goalkeeper saved it in extra time.
959edead-09fb-40b0-b6a3-72e73bd30d5a.intermediate: In minute 122 of extra time, with the score at 3-3, France's Randal Kolo Muani shot from inside the penalty area and the goalkeeper saved it.
959edead-09fb-40b0-b6a3-72e73bd30d5a.tactical: Minute 122, extra time, score level at 3-3. Kolo Muani's shot from the central penalty area was saved by the goalkeeper.

25548b02-1dca-44b0-a1a5-d97f63a69fbd.basic: Offside means a teammate was too far ahead when the ball was played. De Paul's pass in the attacking area was ruled offside.
25548b02-1dca-44b0-a1a5-d97f63a69fbd.intermediate: In minute 2, De Paul played a pass in the attacking third, but it was ruled offside. Score remained 0-0.
25548b02-1dca-44b0-a1a5-d97f63a69fbd.tactical: De Paul's pass in the attacking third was ruled offside in minute 2, with the score 0-0 in the first half.

4ad26294-8aaf-4d69-83dd-bbf9ef797b32.basic: A shot is when a player kicks the ball to try to score. De Paul's shot was blocked at 0-0.
4ad26294-8aaf-4d69-83dd-bbf9ef797b32.intermediate: De Paul fired a shot from the centre of the attacking third in minute 7, but it was blocked, with the score 0-0.
4ad26294-8aaf-4d69-83dd-bbf9ef797b32.tactical: De Paul's shot from the central attacking third was blocked in minute 7, Argentina and France level at 0-0 in the 2022 final.

2a0ff535-d44f-4838-a372-140631fb6184.basic: Offside means a teammate was too far ahead when the ball was played. Tagliafico passed, but a teammate was offside, so the pass was disallowed.
2a0ff535-d44f-4838-a372-140631fb6184.intermediate: Tagliafico's pass in the attacking third was ruled offside at minute 13, with the score 0-0 in the 2022 final.
2a0ff535-d44f-4838-a372-140631fb6184.tactical: Tagliafico played a pass into the left channel of the attacking third at 13 minutes, ruled offside, game state 0-0 in the 2022 final.

5dbcde3d-ba75-483d-a65f-72d2b99ff713.basic: A shot is when a player kicks the ball to try to score. Mbappé's shot was blocked.
5dbcde3d-ba75-483d-a65f-72d2b99ff713.intermediate: Mbappé fired a shot from the centre of the attacking third in minute 92, with the score at 2-2. A defender blocked it.
5dbcde3d-ba75-483d-a65f-72d2b99ff713.tactical: Mbappé's shot from central positions in the attacking third was blocked in minute 92, game state 2-2 in the 2022 final.
